a.lea_note: 32-bit lea SIB scale maxes at 8, so no single lea can produce x16. Counted lea with scale*8: 1117 (these are building blocks for the lea(x*8) + lea/shl pattern, not themselves x16). No lea-based x16 was found on its own.

reconciliation.adjudication: 8 raw-only addresses: 3 are ModRM bytes inside other instructions (0x6ffd76 within '81 c1 a0 04 00 00', 0x72ecf3 within '0f 94 c1', 0x77e730 within '81 c1 24 6c b7 00'); 4 are the C1 byte of a 66-prefixed shl already counted at the 0x66 address (0x7c6aaa/0x7c76ca/0x7c7a8e/0x7c7e62); 1 is a genuine instruction the linear sweep overran during a resync (0x59bdaa 'c1 e0 04 shl eax,4'). Final count = 615 + 1 = 616.

e.caveat: only direct absolute immediates are followed; register/indirect bases (struct field loads, [reg+disp]) are NOT resolved, so 'no' would not have meant absent.
